name: Estrecho Quinto bunker (Huesca front)
story: After July 1936, Nationalist-held Huesca was almost surrounded by Republican columns, and the siege lines around the city lasted until March 1938. In late 1936 Republican forces under Colonel Villalba built this machine-gun bunker at Estrecho Quinto to control the Huesca–Barbastro road. It formed one complex with the positions at Montearagón castle and trench lines nearby. The Huesca front saw costly Republican attacks, above all the June 1937 Huesca offensive, when General Lukács of the XII International Brigade was killed. George Orwell was wounded on this front in May 1937.
see: A well-preserved concrete machine-gun bunker beside the old road, with trench remains on the nearby hills.
plan: It is east of Huesca near Tierz and Loporzano. A quick stop of 15–30 min, freely accessible. There is a marked walking route from Siétamo.
